failure_reason: www.qvc.com is behind Akamai Bot Manager and returns HTTP 418 'currently unavailable' (or a DataDome/Akamai challenge page) for every product-listing or collection-landing URL, confirmed independently across all three access tiers: (1) plain curl and curl_cffi with 4 browser-impersonation profiles (chrome120, safari15_5, edge101, chrome110) all returned 418; (2) Playwright headless Chromium with a real Chrome UA returned HTTP 418 with the Akamai reference-ID error page; (3) Claude-in-Chrome (real logged-in browser) loaded a blank DataDome/Akamai 'Powered and protected by' challenge page with no product content. Only XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and the api.qvc.com JSON search endpoint are unblocked. This matches the prior Home-Decor pass's notes for SR79 (same hard block, same host).
notes: Discovery method: robots.txt (200 OK) -> sitemap-us-index.xml -> sitemap-us-collection.xml (QVC's curated landing-page sitemap, unblocked) -> grepped for new-arrivals/new-in/just-in/latest/what's-new terms. Also checked sitemap-us-navigation-for-the-home.xml and sitemap-us-navigation-garden-and-outdoor-living.xml (the real category-nav trees) -- no New Arrivals entries in either, confirming New Arrivals is not part of QVC's nav-category tree, only its 'collections' landing-page system. Checked sitemap-us-content.xml -- no match. Only one home-department-scoped New Arrivals candidate exists in the sitemap: home-mrs-h-new-arrivals.html (a host/brand-specific New Arrivals collection -- QVC's collection system routinely gives individual on-air hosts/brands their own New Arrivals page, e.g. sibling fashion-jennie-garth-new-arrivals.html, fashion-plw-new-arrivals.html, fashion-wwc-new-arrivals.html for the Fashion department). No general 'home-new-arrivals.html' exists. EXCLUDED as out-of-scope (different QVC department, not Home & Garden): kitchen-new-arrivals.html (Kitchen & Food department -- the prior Home-Decor pass for this same SR explicitly treated Kitchen & Food as out of this company's extraction scope), qcard-new-arrivals.html (QVC's store-credit-card program, cross-department, not home-specific), fashion-*-new-arrivals.html (Fashion department), deals-black-friday-new-arrivals.html (cross-department seasonal Black Friday promo, excluded both for being a seasonal campaign and for scope). No 'New Arrivals' badge/collection facet cross-check was usable as a substitute: api.qvc.com's live search JSON does expose a genuine site facet literally named 'New Arrivals' (Shop By facet 93sl::lhcv), and locked to groupId=lglu (For the Home) with 3-way stopword convergence (searchTerm=the/for/home all returned identical count=1463), giving an exact evidence-backed count for 'For the Home' New Arrivals products -- but this is delivered only through /catalog/psearch.html, a keyword-search URL that robots.txt explicitly disallows and that the brief's own EXCLUDE list names ('arbitrary date-filter pages' / search-results pages), so it is not recorded as a PLP row, only noted here as supporting evidence. Garden & Outdoor Living (groupId gq7tw6) showed the same facet at a non-convergent 52/50/52 across stopwords (totalElements itself varied 1770/1726/1915), so no exact count could be established for that department.

rows.flag: MANUAL REVIEW: URL confirmed genuine via unblocked sitemap-us-collection.xml (home-department-prefixed, host/brand-specific New Arrivals collection); page itself returned HTTP 418 / Akamai-DataDome challenge on every access tier tried (curl, curl_cffi x4 profiles, Playwright headless Chromium, Claude-in-Chrome), so listing content and qty could not be verified.
